ITA-2.6.27 jaraṇaśaktiḥ जरणशक्तिः
Digestive power
The capacity to digest consumed food.

ITA-9.9.21 jarājanyaklaibyam जराजन्यक्लैब्यम्
Senile impotency
Impotency owing to senility and old age.

ITA-1.9.3.7.12 jarāyujaḥ जरायुजः
Viviparous animals
An animal species which undergoes placental birth, e.g. humans, lions, tigers, cows or goats.
